title: ROA Levenslang Leren Enquête - 2017
contributors: Funding Agency: Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid
descriptions: The aim of the survey is to monitor formal learning, informal learning, and knowledge development in the Dutch population. This survey was conducted end 2017, and is a follow-up on the 2013 ROA Life Long Learning Survey which is available from DANS.
